clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, the Hallowed Rune calls novice priests to Anvilmar for training. Branstock Khalder sends the inscribed stone to aspiring wielders of the Holy Light.

Branstock Khalder sends the Hallowed Rune when a young priest proves their resolve by aiding Coldridge Valley’s mountaineers and defenders. The stone bears teachings of the Holy Light and invites them to Anvilmar. There, Branstock prepares them to mend wounds and wield holy power against the troggs threatening Dun Morogh.
